title: Pasig City Regular Academic Scholarship
description: The Pasig City Regular Academic Scholarship is designed for residents of Pasig City who demonstrate high academic performance and are enrolled in recognized higher education institutions. This program provides comprehensive tuition assistance and stipends to support college education for local youths. Applicants must maintain a minimum GWA of 85% or equivalent, with no grade lower than 85% in any subject. Eligibility requires presenting a valid Pasig City LGU ID or Barangay Certificate of Residency proving at least 3 years of residency, and registered voter status for parents or applicants of legal age. Application steps involve registering online via the official Pasig Scholarship portal, uploading scanned requirements, and attending an orientation once approved. Highly recurring cycle opening every first semester of the academic year. Financial need is factored via an annual family income cap of 300,000 PHP.

title: Pasig City Arts and Design Scholarship
description: This dedicated track supports creative individuals residing in Pasig City who pursue fields in fine arts, digital design, music, performing arts, or literature. Eligible applicants must showcase a portfolio or pass a talent audition managed by the Pasig Cultural Affairs Office. Academic requirements are set at a minimum GWA of 80%. Benefits include school fees financial aid and materials allowances. Registration is completed through the online portal, followed by an in-person portfolio review.

title: Taguig LANI Premier Scholarship
description: The Lifeline Assistance for Neighbors in Need (LANI) Premier Scholarship is Taguig City's flagship merit track for top-tier residents studying in prestigious private universities or high-cost specialized institutions (e.g., UP, DLSU, ADMU, UST, Mapua). Applicants must be registered voters of Taguig for at least 3 years and have a minimum GWA of 90% (1.50 or better) with zero failing grades. It offers substantial financial aid up to 50,000 PHP per semester to directly cover tuition fees and modern learning tools. Applications are submitted via the Taguig LANI portal or at the Taguig Civic Center scholarship desk. Highly structured and strictly recurring every semester.

title: Taguig LANI Priority Scholarship
description: This specific LANI track directly targets priority fields of study essential for national development and city workforce planning, including STEM, digital engineering, data analytics, special education, and specialized medical courses. Eligible applicants need a minimum GWA of 82%. Financial benefits are elevated compared to basic tracks, supplying up to 30,000 PHP per semester. Priority status is also given to low-income applicants, PWDs, and dependents of solo parents.

title: Taguig LANI LCU and SUC Assistance Scholarship
description: This scholarship is specially tailored for Taguig residents who are already utilizing the Free Higher Education law at State Universities and Colleges (SUCs) or Local Colleges and Universities (LCUs) like Taguig City University (TCU) or PUP. Since tuition is free, this track converts assistance into a pure monthly cash living stipend of 1,500 PHP plus 2,000 PHP per semester for books. Requires a GWA of 80% and zero failures. Online submission occurs via the unified TCU-LANI interface.

title: Makati City SUC and Priority Courses Scholarship
description: This LGU track caters to Makati residents enrolled in State Universities and Colleges (outside of UMak) pursuing priority industrial fields like IT, engineering, and digital science. It grants 20,000 PHP per semester to offset learning materials, transportation, and field training expenses. It requires 5 years of residency and an overall GWA of 82% (2.25) with no grades lower than 80%. Applications are handled through the Makati Education Department at City Hall.

title: Valenzuela City Dr. Pio Valenzuela Scholarship Program
description: The Dr. Pio Valenzuela Scholarship Program is an intensive LGU merit-need initiative by the Valenzuela City Government. It targets financially challenged but academically elite student residents. Eligible individuals must have spent at least 4 consecutive years in Valenzuela City, graduated Senior High School with a GWA of 85% or higher, and hold zero grades lower than 85% in Grades 11 and 12. Crucially, the total annual household income must not exceed 120,000 PHP. The program awards a financial support grant of 30,000 PHP per year (15,000 PHP per semester) for tuition and school compliance. Portal submissions require uploading digital copies of ITR or Indigency certificates, Form 138/137, and Barangay clearance.

title: NavotaAs Academic College Scholarship
description: The NavotaAs Academic Scholarship Program is the baseline higher-education track for residents of Navotas City. It supports incoming first-year college students who graduated in the top 25% of their Senior High School class. Eligible applicants must have parents who are registered voters of Navotas. When utilized at the Navotas Polytechnic College (NPC), it yields full tuition exemption plus 22,000 PHP per year for allowances. If the student passes into other prominent universities outside Navotas, the grant upgrades to a merit value of 262,000 PHP per year to handle high tuition. Applications are manually screened by the Navotas Scholarship Secretariat.

title: Bislig City Collegiate Scholarship Program
description: The Bislig City Scholarship Program (BCSP) is a localized LGU mandate in Caraga Region enacted to finance undergraduate degrees for local youths. Applicants must confirm 3 consecutive years of residency in Bislig City, present a clean barangay record, and maintain a GWA of 82% throughout college. It provides a flat 12,000 PHP annual educational grant to assist with registration expenses. Submissions are queued physically at the Bislig City Higher Education Desk or via their primary LGU landing page.

title: Ateneo de Manila University Financial Aid Grant
description: The Ateneo de Manila University College Financial Aid Grant is a premium institutional program covering 100%, 75%, 50%, or 25% of tuition and laboratory fees for undergraduate students displaying high academic potential but deep financial need. Administered by the Office of Admission and Aid (OAA), applicants must submit comprehensive household assets records, utility bills, and parents' ITRs. It includes an option for a monthly living allowance of 3,000 PHP and book allowances for absolute 100% grant recipients. Renewal requires an annual review of the family's financial standing and keeping a minimum GWA of 78% (2.0 QPI) with no failing marks. Highly structured and opens annually in September for the subsequent academic year.

title: Ateneo Directors List Scholarship
description: The Director's List Scholarship is extended by the Ateneo OAA to the next tier of top-ranking ACET examinees (top 51-150 nationwide). It grants an annual flat-rate educational stipend of 100,000 PHP directly credited to the recipient's tuition or disbursed as cash allowance across semesters. No financial indicators are used for selection. Recipients must preserve a minimum QPI of 2.50 (83% normalized GWA) and avoid any academic or disciplinary probationary states.

title: UST San Martin de Porres Equity Scholarship
description: The San Martin de Porres Scholarship is UST's foundational equity framework designed for financially marginalized students. Split into internal and external funds, it offers partial to full tuition waivers based on audited household documentation. Eligible candidates must have a GWA of 85% or better and a household annual income below 300,000 PHP. Submissions are processed online through the UST OSA web portal at the start of each academic year.

title: Muntinlupa CARES Financial Assistance Program
description: The Continuing Assistance for Reintegrating Students (CARES) is a equity-driven financial assistance mechanism for general college residents of Muntinlupa who are enrolled in public SUCs or local community colleges. It requires a baseline GWA of 80% (2.5) with no incomplete or failing grades. It disburses a direct financial support grant of 5,000 PHP per semester to cover transport and digital connectivity needs. Financial status is verified via Barangay Certificate of Indigency or low-income ITR. Registration occurs semestrally via the MSD localized offices.

title: Cebu Province CP GIFTS Program
description: The Cebu Province Grants Intended for Tertiary Students (CP-GIFTS) is a massive provincial scholarship initiative under the Office of the Governor. It funds 5,900 concurrent slots for poor but deserving students living across the municipalities and component cities of Cebu Province. Applicants must study at designated SUCs, LUCs, or partner private schools within Cebu and maintain a minimum GWA of 85%. Household income must not cross 200,000 PHP annually. It grants a definitive flat sum of 10,000 PHP per semester for school requirements. A mandatory return component requires executing 160 hours of verified community civic service within the student's home municipality.

title: Parañaque City Tertiary Education Financial Assistance Program
description: The Tertiary Education Financial Assistance Program (TEFAP) is an open-access equity grant run by the Parañaque LGU for resident college students. To fit varying academic profiles, the cash stipend scales directly with academic performance: students maintaining a GWA of 88% and above receive 6,000 PHP per semester, while those with a GWA between 80% and 87% receive 4,000 PHP per semester. Requirements demand 3 years of residency and a parent's voter registration record inside Parañaque. Online registrations are queued via the local city hall portal.

title: Tabuk City College Academic Scholarship
description: Established under Tabuk City Ordinance No. 02 Series of 2018, this program supports tertiary students residing in Tabuk City, Kalinga Province (CAR). It targets low-income households with a maximum annual income cap of 120,000 PHP. Students must maintain a passing GWA of 75% with zero dropped classes to remain qualified. It awards a flat-rate cash assistance grant of 4,000 PHP per semester directly paid to students to handle living costs. Applications are reviewed by the Tabuk City Scholarship Committee at the City Youth and Sports Development Office.

title: NCIP Educational Assistance Program Degree Track
description: The National Commission on Indigenous Peoples Educational Assistance Program (NCIP-EAP) Degree Track is a mandated sector-specific government program designed under NCIP Administrative Order No. 5 Series of 2012 and upgraded via AO No. 6 Series of 2023. It aims to extend tertiary educational access to recognized members of Indigenous Cultural Communities (ICCs/IPs) nationwide. Eligible candidates must secure a Certificate of Confirmation (COCO) from the NCIP Provincial/Regional Office confirming tribal identity. The academic bar requires a general passing GWA of 75% with zero dropped modules. It supplies an annual educational subsidy of 10,000 PHP to 20,000 PHP disbursed through regional offices to offset books, uniform, and field research. Highly recurring cycle synchronized with the fiscal year.

title: NCIP Merit Based Scholarship Program
description: The NCIP Merit-Based Scholarship Program (NCIP-MBS) is a high-tier academic track within the commission reserved for outstanding IP students pursuing competitive national degrees (specifically STEM, Engineering, or Agriculture). Unlike the EAP, the MBS enforces a strict GWA requirement of 85% or higher and puts applicants through a competitive regional examination. It grants an expanded benefit package of 30,000 PHP per year to handle tuition balances or modern learning devices. Administered via the NCIP Bureau of Socio-Economic Literacy and Culture.

title: Department of Agriculture ACEF GIAHEP SUC Track
description: The Agricultural Competitiveness Enhancement Fund Grants-in-Aid for Higher Education Program (ACEF-GIAHEP) SUC Track is a targeted government financial aid tool managed by the Department of Agriculture in compliance with RA 10848. It extends funding to children of registered small farmers, fisherfolk, and agrarian reform beneficiaries who are enrolled in State Universities and Colleges. It covers educational assistance for specific courses in agriculture, agribusiness, agricultural engineering, and fisheries science. Requires a minimum GWA of 75% and presentation of the parent's RSBSA (Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture) certificate. Disburses a flat rate of 15,000 PHP per semester.

title: AFPEBSO DND CHED PASUC Scholarship
description: The AFPEBSO DND-CHED-PASUC Scholarship is a special sector-specific inter-agency government program managed by the Armed Forces of the Philippines Educational Benefit System Office. It extends 100% tuition and fee exemptions at any public State University or College (SUC) for the legitimate children and direct dependents of active-duty, retired, or deceased AFP military personnel. Academic requirements mandate a baseline GWA of 80% (2.5) with zero failures. Financial constraints are secondary to the parent's military service record. Portals accept applications annually from May to July.

title: DSWD AICS Educational Assistance
provider: Department of Social Welfare and Development
description: The DSWD Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) Educational Assistance is a specialized cash intervention program designed for students experiencing extreme economic shock, sudden death of a breadwinner, abandonment, or loss of livelihood due to national disasters. Operated directly through the DSWD Crisis Intervention Units (CIU) or Social Welfare Operations Hubs, it provides a one-time cash grant ranging from 1,000 PHP (Elementary), 2,000 PHP (High School), 3,000 PHP (Senior High), to 4,000 PHP (College/TVET) per semester. Selection ignores GWA rankings but strictly requires an active Case Study Report or Certificate of Indigency from the local MSWDO.

title: Caritas Manila YSLEP Scholarship Program
description: The Youth Servant Leadership and Education Program (YSLEP) is Caritas Manila's primary church-backed financial aid and leadership development initiative. Operating across Catholic dioceses nationwide, it supports poor and marginalized college and TVET students. It pays partial tuition up to 25,000 PHP per year and distributes a modest monthly allowance. Distinctively, selection prioritizes urban-slum families, 4Ps members, and indigenous youth. Recipients must join monthly leadership seminars, church volunteer hours, and community organizing programs. Academic criteria require a baseline 80% GWA with zero failures.

title: Megaworld Foundation Scholarship Program
description: The Megaworld Foundation Scholarship Program is a high-impact mid-market corporate financial assistance framework that funds full undergraduate degrees for underprivileged youths across partner universities in Metro Manila and key regions. It covers 100% of actual tuition and institutional fees, and issues a monthly stipend of 2,500 PHP. Eligible candidates must maintain a GWA of 85% (2.0) with zero dropped subjects and possess a total combined annual household income not exceeding 400,000 PHP. Applications are routed through the Megaworld online portal, requiring an essay on community development and an executive interview.

title: AFPSLAI Educational Grant Program
description: The AFPSLAI Educational Grant Program (EGP) is an affiliation-based financial assistance platform run by the Armed Forces and Police Savings and Loan Association, Inc. It caters to the children and dependents of active or retired military personnel, PNP officers, and uniformed service members who are registered members of AFPSLAI. It delivers a comprehensive flat financial subsidy of 25,000 PHP per semester (50,000 PHP annually) directly to the student to offset undergraduate expenses. Candidates must post a minimum GWA of 85% and possess a clean disciplinary record. Submissions clear through AFPSLAI regional branch hubs.

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarship
description: The Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarship is a highly prestigious international bilateral program funded by the European Union for outstanding Filipino college graduates. It covers 100% of international tuition fees, laboratory charges, global travel costs, visa fees, and delivers a premium monthly living allowance of 1,400 EUR (approximately 88,000 PHP) for the entire 2-year graduate duration. Recipients study in at least three distinct European universities across different EU nations. It requires an elite undergraduate academic record (GWA 90% or equivalent), a comprehensive statement of purpose, academic essays, and dual letters of recommendation. Portals open annually in October.
eligible_courses_specific: All approved European joint master tracks

title: PUP Student Assistantship Program
description: Need-based student assistantship managed by the PUP student services office with rolling applications each semester. Provides work-study opportunities on campus to help enrolled students cover educational expenses.

title: Security Bank External Scholarship Program
description: Private corporate scholarship for college students in NCR pursuing business, STEM, engineering, and IT fields. Requires minimum 86% GWA. Active program with partner university deadlines including PUP and Ateneo through July 31, 2026.

title: Aboitiz Future Leaders Scholarship Program
description: Corporate scholarship for incoming sophomore students enrolled in partner state universities in engineering, data science, communications, and related fields. Covers full tuition, monthly allowance, and academic excellence incentives. Requires cumulative first-year GWA of 2.0 or better on the UP scale with no failing or incomplete grades, plus a mandatory 400-hour internship within Aboitiz Group business units.

title: Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program (BPMSP) - Higher Education Track
description: National merit scholarship for incoming college freshmen under the Bagong Pilipinas framework. SUC scholars receive full tuition; private HEI scholars receive up to 45000 PHP annually for tuition and fees plus a 45000 PHP annual stipend. Requires minimum 95% SHS GWA or top-five batch ranking and combined household income up to 2000000 PHP per year.

title: Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program (BPMSP) - TVET Track
provider: Technical Education and Skills Development Authority
description: TVET diploma track under the joint CHED-DepEd-TESDA Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program. Targets priority diploma programs with minimum 90% GWA and combined household income up to 2000000 PHP. Includes mandatory return-of-service of one year in the Philippines for every year of funding.

title: GSIS Subsidy for STEM Program (GSSP)
description: New STEM-focused subsidy for children of active GSIS members and permanent total disability pensioners under 60. Supports CHED-recognized STEM degree programs for college freshmen with minimum 90% SHS GWA. Provides 15000 PHP annual subsidy per scholar, prioritizing parents in Salary Grade 15 and below.

title: Chevening Scholarship
description: UK Government fully funded one-year master's program in the United Kingdom. Highly competitive global selection based on leadership, networking, career plan, and study proposal. Requires at least 2800 hours of post-graduation work experience and two-year return commitment to the Philippines after completion.
